Task: Python package: add a module app/inventory.py with class Inventory: add(item, qty) adds stock, remove(item, qty) takes stock away and raises ValueError when there is not enough, stock(item) returns the quantity (0 for unknown items). Quantities must be positive integers (ValueError otherwise).
Acceptance criteria:
- add then stock returns the sum
- removing more than in stock raises ValueError and changes nothing
- qty 0 or negative raises ValueError

Plan: Add Inventory class with add, remove, and stock methods handling quantities and errors
Create: app/inventory.py
1. Create app/inventory.py defining class Inventory with required methods and validation
